motions.description: Remove item (a) December minutes from the Consent Agenda and move to new business.
Approve the remaining items on the Consent Agenda (items b through m).
Approve a raffle application submitted by the Leyden Township Community Foundation for their Wild Game Dinner fundraiser at Elmcrest Banquets on January 19, 2026.
Approve recommendations from the Traffic & Safety Commission on traffic/parking improvements including resident parking signs, stop signs, a roundabout, and speed bumps.
Approve the Minutes of the Meeting of the President and Board of Trustees held on December 1, 2025.
Amend the December 1, 2025 minutes to add language to page 5 under New Business specifying the time the meeting reconvened, roll call results, and presence of all members.
